title: 20-Year-Old Nathalia Filgueiras Was a Pilot on Learjet That Crashed in Florida
summary: Nine people died, including two young children and a 20-year-old co-pilot, Nathalia Filgueiras, who received her pilot’s license three years ago, when she was still a teenager.
